label: ai_systems
note: Number of AI systems in scope (inventory count or best estimate).

label: assessment_hours_per_system
note: Person-hours to complete one risk/impact assessment today.

label: hourly_cost
note: Blended fully loaded hourly cost of people doing governance work.

label: audit_prep_hours_per_year
note: Person-hours per year assembling AI evidence for audits, customers and regulators.

label: approval_cycle_days
note: Average calendar days from use-case intake to approval decision today.

label: assessments_per_system_per_year
note: Assessments or reassessments per system per year (initial, change-triggered, periodic).

label: new_use_cases_per_year
note: New AI use cases going through approval per year.

label: delay_cost_per_day
note: Business value lost per use case per day of approval delay. Default 0 excludes this benefit.

label: annual_incident_probability
note: Probability of at least one material AI incident in a year.

label: expected_incident_cost
note: Expected cost of a material AI incident (response, remediation, legal, customer impact).

label: aegis_annual_cost
note: Annual AEGIS subscription from the commercial proposal (pricing is itself a hypothesis).

label: implementation_cost
note: One-time cost, e.g. Governance Baseline fee and internal implementation effort.

label: assessment_effort_reduction
note: Share of assessment effort removed by agent-assisted, pre-populated assessments.

label: audit_prep_reduction
note: Share of audit-preparation effort removed by continuous evidence capture and evidence packs.

label: approval_cycle_reduction
note: Share of approval cycle time removed by triage, routing and complete submissions.

label: incident_likelihood_reduction
note: Relative reduction in material-incident likelihood from runtime guardrails, testing and oversight.

label: realization_rate
note: Share of modelled benefit realized in year 1, reflecting adoption ramp.

label: Assessment effort today (hours/yr)
note: depends on: ai_systems, assessment_hours_per_system, assessments_per_system_per_year

label: Assessment cost today
note: depends on: hourly_cost

label: Assessment hours saved
note: depends on: assessment_effort_reduction

label: Assessment cost saving
note: depends on: assessment_effort_reduction

label: Audit-preparation cost today
note: depends on: audit_prep_hours_per_year, hourly_cost

label: Audit-preparation hours saved
note: depends on: audit_prep_reduction

label: Audit-preparation cost saving
note: depends on: audit_prep_reduction

label: Approval days saved per use case
note: depends on: approval_cycle_days, approval_cycle_reduction

label: Time-to-value benefit
note: depends on: new_use_cases_per_year, delay_cost_per_day

label: Expected annual incident loss today
note: depends on: annual_incident_probability, expected_incident_cost

label: Risk-reduction value (expected)
note: depends on: incident_likelihood_reduction

label: Gross modelled annual benefit
note: derived

label: Year-1 realized benefit
note: depends on: realization_rate

label: Governance hours freed per year (modelled)
note: derived

label: Year-1 cost
note: depends on: aegis_annual_cost, implementation_cost

label: Year-1 net benefit
note: derived

label: Steady-state annual net benefit
note: depends on: aegis_annual_cost
